title: The role of 316 SS surface finishes in enhancing corrosion protection of conducting polyaniline coatings
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27269-27286
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01684G, Paper

Dat Minh Tran, Anh Thi Nhat Cao, Ngo Thanh Binh, Nhung Thi Nguyen, Casen Panaitescu, Duong Ngo Kim Long, Nhi Ngoc Nguyen, Nam Nguyen Dang
In the context of polymer-based anticorrosive coating, a surface finish strongly influences the adhesive and protective performance of polymer molecules on the metallic surface, particularly stainless steel (SS) as immersed in the simulated seawater.
